_comment: Hand-set climate of the Alduran hyper-desert (a world-specific biome; the simulator cannot produce it). Edit freely; tools/reconcile.py and tools/alduran_patch.py read this file.
months: 0 = month after the northern winter solstice (Earth: January); the hottest month is index 6 (July), the coldest index 0 (January)
_figures_note: the single numbers are the middle of the typical ranges; the map's temperature layer shows the monthly MEAN of day and night, the day / night figures are shown on hover
_rain_note: a few strong flash rains, 5-10 minutes each, about one every one or two years; the monthly climate is a flat 20 mm / 12
blend_note: the hand-set climate fades in over this many 1024x512 cells (~0.35 deg each) INSIDE the border of the hyper-desert; it is 0 on the border and 1 from blend_cells inward. Nothing outside the hyper-desert is changed.
lapse_note: 0 = your day/night figures are used as the real surface values everywhere inside Alduran, including on its high ground. Set 6.5 to cool the high parts.
